# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 5 tokens; Text — 4 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 5 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 58 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Stroke — 4 tokens; Density — 4 tokens; Duration — 3 tokens; Z index — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | #f9f6f2 | #0f1215 | Page ground in Studio. Light: paper with a faint warm cast so eight-hour sessions do not glare. Dark: graphite. Every text token is verified against it. |
| `surface-raised` | #fefcf9 | #171a1e | Panels, table bodies, cards, the stage rail track. One step above `surface`; separated by `border`, never by shadow. |
| `surface-sunken` | #f1eee9 | #090b0f | Wells: table headers, inputs, code and fingerprint blocks, the budget meter track. |
| `surface-overlay` | #fefdfb | #1d2125 | Dialogs and popovers only (the park-and-ask dialog, command palette). Pairs with `shadow-overlay`. |
| `surface-inverse` | #151a20 | #ece9e4 | Inverse fields: the RECOVERY_REQUIRED block, tooltips, the keyboard-shortcut overlay. |

### Use


### Tokens (4)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | #151a20 | #ece9e4 | Primary text and every figure a conclusion rests on. >= 7:1 (AA-plus) on all surfaces and status washes in both themes. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */

/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (58)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `signal` | #006b9f | #6ac5e8 | The one precise accent: selection, links, the live edge of a RUNNING process, the primary action. Used sparingly — never decoration, never for a warning. |
| `signal-wash` | #d7edfb | #123144 | Selected row / selected stage background. `ink` stays >= 7:1 on it. |
| `focus-ring` | #006b9f | #6ac5e8 | The 2px focus outline, always drawn with a 2px `surface` gap so it sits on a known ground; >= 3:1 on every surface in both themes. |

| `status-you` | #f5ae39 | #f7b746 | RESERVED for "parked, waiting on a person" (WAITING_USER, AWAITING_GATE, AWAITING_BUDGET, WAITING_CREDITS). Solid fill, the loudest thing on any screen. Never used for anything else — not warnings, not highlights, not a data series. |

| `status-recovery` | #151a20 | #ece9e4 | RECOVERY_REQUIRED block fill: inverse ink. The rarest, most serious state — a decision about money that may already be spent. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-studio-title);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `studio-title` | `.studio-title`, `--text-studio-title` | 20px / 26px | 600 | `sans` | Page title: study or screen name. One per screen. |
| `studio-heading` | `.studio-heading`, `--text-studio-heading` | 15px / 20px | 600 | `sans` | Panel and section headings. |
| `studio-body` | `.studio-body`, `--text-studio-body` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Default UI text in comfortable density. |
| `studio-body-compact` | `.studio-body-compact`, `--text-studio-body-compact` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Dense tables: respondent explorer, usage ledger, run log. |
| `studio-label` | `.studio-label`, `--text-studio-label` | 12px / 16px | 500 | `sans` | Status chip labels, field labels, table headers. Sentence case, never all caps (Czech diacritics collide with caps height). |
| `studio-caption` | `.studio-caption`, `--text-studio-caption` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `sans` | Metadata and timestamps. 12px is the floor: nothing in AIA is set smaller. |

| `num-hero` | `.num-hero`, `--text-num-hero` | 28px / 32px | 500 | `sans` | The one figure of a headline answer or a budget meter total. |
| `mono` | `.mono`, `--text-mono` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `mono` | Identifiers: fingerprints, revision ids, run and step ids, ledger row ids. Slashed zero on (font-feature-settings "zero"). |
| `mono-sm` | `.mono-sm`, `--text-mono-sm` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `mono` | Identifiers inside compact tables and the run log. |
| `doc-title` | `.doc-title`, `--text-doc-title` | 44px / 48px | 600 | `display` | Report cover title. Display optical size. |
| `doc-h1` | `.doc-h1`, `--text-doc-h1` | 26px / 32px | 600 | `serif` | Report chapter heading, numbered. |

| `doc-body` | `.doc-body`, `--text-doc-body` | 15px / 24px | 400 | `serif` | Report prose. Prints at 10.5pt / 16.8pt. |

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`) and upload it as an asset where you use it (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) — HTML/CSS: an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule; a Slides deck: write `fonts/<id>` = `{"family":"<family>","src":"<the url the upload returned>"}`. `tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that inlines it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `fonts/<id>` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IBM Plex Sans | `fonts/IBMPlexSans-Regular.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-sans)` | `ibm-plex-sans` |
| IBM Plex Mono | `fonts/IBMPlexMono-Regular.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-mono)` | `ibm-plex-mono` |
| Source Serif 4 | `fonts/SourceSerif4-Regular.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-serif)` | `source-serif-4` |
| Source Serif 4 Display | `fonts/SourceSerif4Display-Semibold.woff2` (weight 600) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-display)` | `source-serif-4-display` |

Every face: `fonts/IBMPlexSans-Regular.woff2` (IBM Plex Sans, 400), `fonts/IBMPlexSans-Italic.woff2` (IBM Plex Sans, 400, italic), `fonts/IBMPlexSans-Medium.woff2` (IBM Plex Sans, 500), `fonts/IBMPlexSans-SemiBold.woff2` (IBM Plex Sans, 600), `fonts/IBMPlexMono-Regular.woff2` (IBM Plex Mono, 400), `fonts/IBMPlexMono-Medium.woff2` (IBM Plex Mono, 500), `fonts/SourceSerif4-Regular.woff2` (Source Serif 4, 400), `fonts/SourceSerif4-Italic.woff2` (Source Serif 4, 400, italic), `fonts/SourceSerif4-Semibold.woff2` (Source Serif 4, 600), `fonts/SourceSerif4Display-Semibold.woff2` (Source Serif 4 Display, 600).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-half);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-half` | 2px | Glyph-to-label gap inside chips; gaps between stacked meter segments. |
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon padding; compact cell vertical padding. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Cell horizontal padding; gap between chips. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Control padding; compact panel padding. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Panel padding; mobile side gutter. |
| `space-6` | 24px | Gap between panels; dialog padding. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Section spacing in Studio. |
| `space-12` | 48px | Deliverable margins and chapter spacing. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-0) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-0` | 0px | Tables, the stage rail, the scope bar, report figures. Precision reads square. |
| `radius-sm` | 2px | Chips, inputs, buttons, cells with a state fill. |
| `radius-md` | 4px | Panels, dialogs, popovers. The largest radius in the system. |

## Duration

### Use

```css
/* var(--duration-instant) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `duration-instant` | 0ms | Everything under prefers-reduced-motion. |
| `duration-confirm` | 120ms | State-change confirmation: a chip changing status, a row selected. Motion confirms a transition that happened; it never anticipates one. |
| `duration-panel` | 180ms | Panels and dialogs opening. |

## Z index

### Use

```css
/* var(--z-scope) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `z-scope` | 30 | The scope bar: above all page content, it must never scroll away or be covered. |
| `z-overlay` | 40 | Dialogs and popovers. |
| `z-toast` | 50 | Transient confirmations. Never used for a parked or failed state — those live in the page. |
